O: a report of the state of the room's mark comes first and a marking of the finished work follows it, so {el}'s order is shown; a specification
M: a plain report that the work is made or done is answered by a marking, so the order is shown in the members' words (the mechanism in words, which the census counts apart); a specification
J: the room's first report is itself a marking that states the work done, finished or on the canvas (G15's 'done' and the cheer; G16's announcement), with no separate earlier report, so the first act of each is one act and {el}'s order cannot be read; the census counts it apart
ONE: only one end is shown: a marking with no report of the build, a report with no marking of the finished work, or a cheer for one part or for progress while the work is unfinished; {el}'s order is not shown
BOUND: the marking comes before a report that the work is still unfinished, or marks a find made by others before the room builds: the bound's first sentence; {el}'s order is not shown
BOUND2: the close cut the work unfinished and the room marks the attempt: the bound's second sentence, read in its words (QD3-007); {el}'s order is not shown
FAM: the room marks an attempt that ended before the close without a finished work, the family D3a-13 left as a paired elaboration of P11; {el}'s order is not shown, and the census counts it apart
OTHER: the only report comes after hour 73 (P12), or the report is another room's own and the room's members do not take it up; {el}'s order is not shown on the canvas
P-G6: the line is marked NONPORTABLE and fails portability, a particular (G6)
